title: Graphs and a field
alt: A sine curve with the area from 0 to 3.14 shaded, beside a vector field that turns counterclockwise.

steps.say: The engine samples y = a sin x and shades the area from 0 to 3.14.
steps.alt: A sine curve of height 1 with the hump from 0 to 3.14 shaded and the point (1.57, 1) marked.

steps.say: Setting a to 1.5 stretches every height by 1.5.
steps.alt: The same curve, now of height 1.5; the marked point is (1.57, 1.5).

steps.say: Each arrow is (-y, x) at its cell, so the field turns counterclockwise.
